tests.name: Plugin is active, tables exist and the header has the exact name
Admin menu shows the exact plugin name
The owner's 21 categories exist in order, with the supplied topic URLs where they apply, and can be edited, added, disabled, duplicated, reordered and deleted
Upgrading from 1.0 adds the missing categories, leaves existing ones untouched and is not repeated
Names with "&" work end to end: form, WordPress category, repeated lookups and the post
A category added later is used only once it is ready, and its status says why not
Default article prompt matches the supplied text in every checked detail
Prompts with unusual content are stored and returned byte for byte
Start refuses when configuration is missing, and starts persistent processing when ready
Start refuses an unavailable model, shows an error and does not substitute another
Connection test reports success, bad keys and missing models clearly
Settings validate input and persist through a reload
State machine rejects invalid transitions and logs them
API key is encrypted at rest and only a masked hint is available
Single user mode is the default, and upgrading to version 11 keeps slots, the Post author and posting exactly as before
Schedule values are checked: times, timezone, weekdays, dates, posts at each time, limits and the missed rule, each with a clear message
A time within 15 minutes of another author is refused on save, across timezones and a daylight-saving change, and too many times together give a warning
Times are planned per author in the author's timezone, follow weekdays, From and Until and dates to skip, and an author added mid-day gets only the times left
With 2 posts at one time, 2 slots are planned and filled one after another for the same author
An author's categories limit the category of their times, the article chosen, the fallback and the research
Each post is credited to the author whose time it is, not to the Post author, including after a crash
A paused, revoked or deleted author's time is not used: the article waits for another author, no AI is spent for them, and the check is repeated right before the post
Daily, weekly and monthly limits, counted in the author's own calendar with weeks from Monday, stop their times and their research
The site's Maximum posts per day and Maximum article generations per day stay ceilings above every author
A missed time follows the author's own rule: published at that author's next time, or skipped
Switching modes needs an active author with a schedule, plans the coming times again, never keeps both, and is logged with who switched
Start Automation in Multiple users mode asks for a scheduled author instead of the Post author
Past-Hour Posting in Multiple users mode searches only the author's categories, credits the author, and uses the story age as set
The Authors page has the Posting mode card and schedule form, both save through checked forms, and other screens show the author
Logs name the author on schedule changes, posts and times not used, and can be filtered by that person
Recency filters: past hour, 24 hours, week and custom range are applied to story dates
The filter really applied is recorded, and unsupported filters are disclosed
RSS, Atom and sitemaps parse, and hostile XML is refused
A real fetch through the plugin stores new stories and applies keyword filters
Duplicates are caught by URL, tracking variants, canonical, story id, headline and text
Text similarity detects a near-copy and separates unrelated text
Each source failure is held or recorded, and no AI request is made for it
HTTP 429 honors Retry-After, 5xx retries with backoff, and both stop at the limit
A readable page yields metadata, clean text and a move to AI
Source threshold is configurable
SSRF checks refuse private networks, unsafe schemes and credentials
robots.txt rules: agent groups, longest match and wildcards
A Google-style link is resolved through the publisher feed, and is not guessed when there is no match
Extractor handles JSON-LD, paywall signs, encodings and page chrome
An article inside a block named like page chrome is kept, while real chrome is removed
Canonical links are made absolute
A name that cannot be looked up is a temporary network problem, and real refusals stay refusals
An unreadable robots.txt retries the story instead of blocking it, and a real refusal still blocks it
A publisher feed is retried when its robots.txt is unreadable, and is refused when it disallows
An outage while matching a Google story is retried and is not remembered as "no feed"
A private address is refused however it is written in IPv6, and public addresses still pass
Parser separates title and body from HTML
Parser handles Markdown with table and lists, code fences, labels and preambles
Parser removes every image form, and script tags are stripped too
Tag parsing: comma split, trim, case-insensitive de-duplication, lead-ins and numbering
A complete article passes, and metrics stay in diagnostics
Each defect is caught with its own error
Target misses are warnings: the word and readability goals do not block an article
The request uses the configured model and the exact prompt version, with the source placed before it
A prompt edit during a job does not change that job
A full run through retrieval, AI, tags and validation reaches the queue
Invalid key pauses AI, shows a clear error, and makes no repeated calls
No credits pauses AI, and publishing can still run
A model that disappears later is not swapped for another
429 waits for Retry-After, and temporary errors retry and then succeed
Persistent provider failure stops at the limit and is marked failed
Network timeout and unreadable replies are retried, and errors inside a 200 are understood
Moderation refusal fails that article only and does not pause AI
Malformed output retries with the same prompt, then is held and never queued
A bad first answer followed by a good one proceeds normally
Tag policy: fewer than 20 retries then holds, more than 20 keeps 20, and duplicates are removed
A forbidden dash is replaced under the default policy and noted in diagnostics
Provider-reported tokens and cost are recorded
A missing cost is fetched from the generation endpoint, and stays Unavailable if it cannot be read
The daily AI limit stops further generations
OpenRouter status codes map to the right recovery action
Default schedule: 10:00, 16:00 and 22:00 at UTC+10:30, with correct UTC times
Schedule settings are honored, and slots that would cross midnight are not created
Daylight saving: slots keep their wall-clock time in a named zone, and a fixed offset never moves
Starting mid-day does not count earlier slots as due, and the day continues at the next slot
A title nested in a wrapper element is found, and text before it is still reported
Round robin rotation: no repeat in a day while alternatives exist, and it continues the next day
Rotation modes: per slot, weighted, pools, disabled categories and active days
Draft mode creates a draft with every field mapped correctly and its featured image
Automatic mode publishes with no approval, and a category can override the mode
Owner's setup out of the box: only the API key is needed, nothing posts before Start, then articles go live in new WordPress categories
Options: visible attribution, reuse-only tags, category mapping and no auto-create
The daily cap is never exceeded, however many articles are ready
The cap resets exactly at local midnight in UTC+10:30, not at UTC midnight
Cap scope: drafts and published are counted separately, and "published only" ignores drafts
A timeout after the post is created does not create a second post on retry
A crash before meta is written still finds the post, and a lost mapping is not duplicated
Two workers cannot publish the same item, and the database refuses a second mapping
A WordPress post error retries and then stops at PUBLISH_FAILED, and can be retried by hand
Catch-up "publish next available": an empty slot is deferred, then filled at the next slot time
Catch-up "skip": a missed slot stays missed, and an unfilled slot closes when the day ends
A worker outage past the grace period defers the slot with a clear reason, and cannot exceed the cap
Old queued articles are skipped, and the same-category article is preferred with fallback when empty
Duplicates are checked before queue entry and again before the post is created
Pause Research stops discovery and retrieval while publishing continues, and the state persists
Pause Publishing stops post creation while research and AI continue
Stop cancels future work, keeps records, and a job claimed earlier does not start new ones
Stop takes effect at the next safe checkpoint during a worker run
Stale running jobs are recovered and shown, and a dead worker is reported
A job that keeps crashing stops at its limit, and only one worker runs at a time
Retry item and Skip item work and respect the current state
Every pipeline stage and control action is logged, and logs filter and redact
The API key never appears in logs, stored responses, usage, jobs or any admin page
Non-administrators are refused on pages, actions, AJAX and the worker endpoint needs its token
All screens render without PHP warnings, in empty and populated states
The background refresh reports the current state, so Starting changes to Running without a reload
Timezone is shown next to times on the Schedule page, and a slot overflow warning appears
Daily maintenance applies retention and never touches posts
Deactivation stops scheduled work and keeps everything; uninstall removes data only when chosen
The plugin source contains no image generation, no other third-party services and no external assets
From Start to a published post with no admin session, through discovery, AI and slot time
Research waits until a slot is close, so news is not chosen today and published tomorrow
The research lead time can be changed, and it stays within its limits
A CC BY image is imported, set as featured, verified, and its full credit is stored
A verified public domain image is assigned
A CC0 image is assigned
With CC BY-SA turned off, it is rejected, the file is not downloaded, and the article is held
CC BY-NC is rejected
CC BY-ND is rejected
Unknown, conflicting, restricted and creator-less licenses are rejected
A low resolution, portrait, oversized or wrong-type file is rejected
A previously used image is never reused, even across categories and days
After deleting the post and the Media Library file, the image stays reserved until an admin releases it
Two simultaneous jobs: separate PHP processes race, and exactly one gets the image
Corrupted, truncated, flat, redirected and non-image files are refused, and the next file is used
When the best file is corrupted, the next good file is used
A failed download waits and retries without regenerating the article, its tags, or a second post
A Commons rate limit stops the searches and honors Retry-After; attempts are bounded
A failed assignment is logged, the post stays a draft, and Retry image reuses the same file
With "hold" set, no usable image keeps the article out of public view, and Retry works
The credit shows once, directly after the image, with working creator, source and license links
A theme or builder that skips the thumbnail filter still shows the credit once, at the top of the text
Modification details show when recorded, and values are escaped
Creator-less CC0 and public domain credits are honest; "required only" hides them
No credit on blog listings, feeds, other posts, or while the page head is built
Draft mode: a draft gets the image and credit
Automatic mode: the post is not public until its image and credit are in place
The image is found while the article waits in the queue, and reused at the slot with no second search
Three posts a day stays three: the daily cap is not used by images, and no search runs once it is met
Stop and Pause publishing still hold: no image search runs
Crash after the post is created: recovery finishes the same post with the same image
A crash during download gives the reservation back on the next attempt
The same picture under another name is refused: exact copy, and a re-saved copy
Label rules refuse adult, graphic, watermarked, non-photo, children and victim files; score has a floor
Old saved settings that allowed a post without an image are ignored: images cannot be turned off
Upgrading removes the old image switches, adds the retry column, and says so
Admin screens show image settings, tools, history, status and totals with no PHP notices
Retry image is offered for a post published before images were required, which stays published, and a subscriber cannot use the admin actions
Only approved hosts can supply an image file, and bad replies from the API are handled
Article analysis keeps place names, finds the subject, and makes 3 to 5 searches
A file with padding after the picture is accepted, and a download smaller than Commons states is refused
A DNS failure during the Commons search waits and retries, and does not end the image attempt
A DNS failure during a download gives the image back, and does not block it forever
Title Case headlines give real names, not the whole headline
An ordinary word or a piece of a word cannot make a people photo count as being about the article
While publishing is paused, recovery after a crash does not publish, and it finishes after Resume
The credit names the file, including on older posts that saved no title, and the title is escaped
The credit stays when the plugin is deactivated, and shows only once while it runs
Older posts get the copy on upgrade and deactivation, without changing their dates
A long wait from Wikimedia is respected: nothing is sent, and a short wait is slept through
An article waits out a long Wikimedia wait without using up an attempt, then gets its image
A rate limit partway through the searches does not end the image attempt when nothing suitable has been found yet
A rate limit after a file already taken waits too, and attempts stay bounded
A good file found before the rate limit is used straight away
A rate limit reported inside a normal reply counts as a rate limit
A CC BY-SA image is imported and fully credited, and turning it off later leaves the post as it is
CC BY-SA gets the same strict checks as CC BY, and related licenses stay refused
The people rule still applies to CC BY-SA files
The CC BY-SA box is on the Images page, with its warning about editing
A name written with 's, or later by surname alone, still searches for the full name
A resized copy is downloaded when Commons offers one, and the admin preview uses a small standard width
Searches ask Commons only for large enough files, and stop once a strong match is found
The AI tags confirm names: a cleaner tag becomes the subject, and a single word is searched alone only when it is a tag
A post from this plugin cannot go public by hand, or on a schedule, without a featured image that loads. Other posts are not affected
If the featured image file is gone at publishing, the post stays a draft, and it goes out once the file is back
A slot takes the article whose image is ready, and the next one gets its image straight after
A held article gets one more image search 6 hours later, and only one
When a strong match ends the searching but its file cannot be used, the other searches run and their file is used
Scenario 1: Past-Hour Posting is on by default on a fresh install, with a limited preparation time
Scenario 2: a fresh story is found, written and published at the post time, with its ages recorded
A story from before the window is not written, even though it is under 60 minutes old when the search runs
Scenario 3: nothing at first, one search every 15 minutes, and a story appearing during a retry is used
Scenario 4: other categories are tried only from 09:30, one at a time, and the first with a story ends the search
The planned category is preferred over a newer story elsewhere, and "use another category" being off is respected
Scenario 5: no category has news, so the post is skipped with the exact reason and nothing is written
Scenario 6: a story that goes over 60 minutes during writing is dropped, and no more is spent on it
While there is time, a story that stops qualifying is replaced by another one that does
An article page dated older than its feed entry is rejected before any AI call, and a newer or unstated page date changes nothing
Scenario 7: a ready article is not published when the story is over 60 minutes old at publishing
The final check runs after the image step: time lost finding an image stops the post, and the image is given back
Scenario 8: a skipped post stays skipped, its story is not used later, and the next post is unaffected
Articles queued before Past-Hour Posting was turned on are not published, and preparation that never ran skips the post
Scenario 9: repeated searches and workers cause one article per post, one post per article, and no shared story
Failed stories are replaced without AI spending, and each post writes at most 2 articles
No article is started while publishing is paused, AI is blocked, or the daily limits are reached, and the reason is recorded
Scenario 10: turned off, the earlier workflow runs: hourly research, older stories, the buffer and the queue
Turned off part way through, an article already prepared simply joins the earlier workflow, and retries work again
All sources follow the same rules: real publication dates only, and Google asked for the last hour
Preparation time can be changed, the plugin timezone sets the clock, and a short preparation can use other categories at once
The image is found during preparation and reused at publishing, and while Wikimedia is down the post waits, then is skipped, never going out without an image
With an image required and none found, the post is skipped, and failed content is never published
The Dashboard shows the status, times, story, ages, category, fallback, processing and result of each post
The Schedule page has both settings and they save, and the Logs filter has the new stage
Upgrading adds the new columns, turns the feature on, keeps existing settings, and records it
Unused stories do not pile up forever, and stale searches for a closed post are dropped
Categories with a Google topic also have a search covering the story age, and an upgrade adds it without touching what the owner changed
A story from a publisher feed is tried before a newer Google News story, and a Google story is used when no feed has one
The Dashboard does not show a dropped story as the chosen one, and says when preparation is already under way
A story with no usable image gives way to another story, and the post goes out with an image
Stories up to 2 hours old are used by default: preparation starts at 08:00 for a 10:00 post, and a story from 08:20 goes out
With a 2-hour window other categories are tried from halfway, 60 minutes before the post, not 30
The story age and preparation time are checked together, and neither is longer than the gap between posts
Google is asked for the whole window, in whole hours, and each story date is still checked here
Upgrading moves a 60-minute preparation time to 120 and adds the 120-minute story age, but keeps a time the owner chose
The Schedule form saves the story age, and a preparation time longer than it is marked on the form
Nobody is authorised automatically: a fresh install has no author, Automation cannot start, and an administrator gets no access by role
Access can be granted, paused, resumed and revoked, one user or many, and each change records who made it
Each post is credited to the active Post author, and the post, its link and the log all record it
A paused or revoked author is never credited: the article is held, research waits, and Retry publishes it once they are active again
A deleted WordPress user shows as User missing, is recorded in Logs, and is never credited
A WordPress role change is recorded and changes nothing here, and granting access never changes a role
The Authors page lists username, name, email and role, can be searched and filtered, and only plugin administrators can open it
Grant, pause and revoke are checked on the server: a row button, a bulk choice, refused without the nonce or the capability, and the filters are kept
With Past-Hour Posting, no story is chosen and no AI is spent while there is no active author, and the post is skipped
Publishing one of the plugin's drafts outside the worker records who did it
Upgrading authorises only the user already credited, or else the first administrator, and nobody else
Logs show names instead of numbers and the credited author, and can be filtered by person
Off by default: both limits are 0, nothing stops by itself, and the worker runs as before
The post limit stops automation right after the post that reaches it, like the Stop button: the next article stays queued, the tick is cancelled and no later post is made
Drafts do not count toward the post limit
Both limits count from the last Start, and count again from 0 after a new Start, which works exactly as before
The days limit stops the worker 24 hours per day after Start, even while paused, before any job runs
With both limits set, whichever comes first stops automation, and the summary says so
The limits accept whole numbers from 0 to 365 days and 0 to 10000 posts, and nothing else
The Schedule page has its own Automatic stop form: saving checks the nonce, does not rebuild the schedule, logs the change, and warns when a limit is already reached
The Dashboard shows the limits, says when automation stopped by itself and why, and stops saying so after a new Start or a manual Stop
A limit reached partway through a worker run stops it at the next safe checkpoint, before another job starts
The Plugins page shows InkRush by Sagor Das, with the tagline, while the file, slug and text domain are unchanged
The menu and page titles say InkRush, while every page slug is unchanged
Every admin page shows InkRush with the tagline at the top and the developer attribution at the bottom
OpenRouter sees the app name InkRush, while the user agent and robots token keep their original names
The log export downloads as inkrush-logs-…csv, and the release ZIP is named inkrush-{version}.zip with the original folder inside
